property_summary: For any admissible order fill followed by a successful transferFrom of the taker's position to a recipient, that recipient can in turn transfer the token onward (ownership really moved); the mutant never updates _ownerOf, so the recipient's onward transfer reverts with WRONG_FROM.
change_summary: Remove the state update `_ownerOf[id] = to;` so transferFrom no longer changes ownership of the token.
